operations.description: Creates a new `ManagementDnsZoneBinding` resource in a private cloud. This RPC creates the DNS binding and the resource that represents the DNS binding of the consumer VPC network to the management DNS zone. It contains FQDNs and corresponding IP addresses for the private cloud's ESXi hosts and management VM appliances like vCenter and NSX Manager.
